limitations.note: The agent fixed the counter clocking but made square mode drive low before count 9 instead of holding the previous output until count 9 or 19, changing what happens when switching into square mode.
The rewrite makes the triangle rise immediately from zero, whereas the original and reference reset the direction flag to decrement first, producing 31 on the first triangle clock after reset.
The bench expected square mode to force zero on entry and triangle mode to rise immediately after reset, so it passed the rewrite without detecting either regression.

limitations.quote: A local test that checks only the rewritten timing assumptions can pass while missing observable changes to reset and phase boundaries.
limitations.note: The agent retrieved a directly relevant warning, but it did not change the approach: the rewrite altered startup and mode transitions, and the bench treated the new behavior as correct.
